description: Bar Chart with Dynamic Range Creation by Office Solution This tool helps users analyze data by creating X-Axis buckets or categories themselves, allowing users to define the bucket level at which they want to aggregate numbers. Key Features: Users can create numeric aggregation buckets as per their requirements at run time. Users can draw an additional Average line at each individual bar level or overall chart level. Users can compare if an individual KPI is increasing or decreasing in relation to another KPI. Business users can change X-Axis dimensions/Measures dynamically at run time. Business users can change Y-Axis dimensions/Measures dynamically at run time. Business users can change X Legends dynamically at run time. Business users can focus only on the top 5 or top 10 areas. Users can add an additional KPI represented as icons at the end of bars with conditional formatting applied, helping assess whether key KPI indicators are performing well.
